event: Remnants of Hurricane Ida, 1–2 September 2021, as described by the cited reports
note: Sources are news reports, not a flooded-segment inventory. Unverified places stay unverified. The scenario is not scored, and it is not validated.

places.title: Quaker Road

claims.statement: Evening update: Quaker Road, Mercer Road, and Stockton Street (Route 206) were still closed.
Listed Quaker Road among roads currently closed, with Mercer Road, Stockton Street (Rt. 206), and South Harrison Street.
Quaker Road between Mercer Street and the West Windsor border was still closed because of a large sinkhole.
Quaker Road between Mercer Road and Nassau Park Boulevard remained closed for a sinkhole and other damage. Municipal engineer Deanna Stockton had no reopening estimate.

Still closed between Province Line and Mercer roads. The Princeton/Lawrence side of the bridge over the Delaware and Raritan Canal had collapsed. A pipe toward the Stony Brook near Updike Farm needed repair.
The stretch between Mercer Road and Province Line Road reopened after being closed since the beginning of September.

claims.source: Carolyn Jones, hosted by Eastern Surplus
claims.statement: A later account of the night of 1 September 2021: the Stony Brook, which crosses Rosedale Road, rose and breached the bridge during a rescue. This is not a contemporaneous closure log.
A pipe from a ditch to the Stony Brook near Updike Farm on Quaker Road needed repair. That is damage beside the road, not a named crossing closure.
